name: Tame Owl 66
author: KhaledMatalkah
description: 3d gray checkbox that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: On hover, text color changes from #333 to #666, border-color becomes #666, background-color changes to #f0f0f0. Clicking it toggles it: background-color changes to #333, border-color becomes #333, transform becomes scale(1.1) rotateZ(360deg) rotateY(360deg). On focus, box-shadow becomes 0 0 3px 2px #000000, the outline is removed.
